items.article_text:
Post oficial de @pearljam no Instagram (CAROUSEL_ALBUM), 2026-11-06T14:01:52+0000.

Legenda original:
From CBGB to the pages of Punk magazine, Roberta Bayley captured New York’s early punk scene through her unique lens. Tonight, she joins Jeff and Barry Ament at The Strand to moderate a conversation about Since Forever, exploring the photographs and stories behind Jeff’s visual memoir.
